title: Vale Salobo CPF project execution update
publisher: Vale S.A. via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: The project is expected to add 6 million tonnes of annual ore-processing capacity and up to approximately 30,000 tonnes of annual copper production.
summary: Vale advanced Salobo coarse-particle flotation to execution with first-half 2028 start-up expected, approximately USD 215 million estimated capital expenditure before USD 40 million of Wheaton funding, and up to about 30,000 tonnes of annual copper plus 15,000 ounces of by-product gold.
